column5: Created from a chunk of rock broken off of a Dark Anchor dolmen, this amulet still whispers with Coldharbour's secrets.
A simple band made from Dwarven metal, it bears incomprehensible runes in the Dwemeris tongue.
Worn by the forgemasters of the Fighters Guild as they work superheated metals at the Earth Forge.
Aelif purchased this at a little shop in Dune, on the border of Elsweyr, for the price of a man's darkest secret.
The pure fire of Meridia's Gift emanates from within the blade. Just holding it in your hand makes the darkness retreat.
